nodes.Name: NodeKind
nodes.DocComment: NodeKind discriminates the type of a Node.

nodes.Name: Pos
nodes.DocComment: Pos is a single point in a source file.

Fields.Name: Offset
Fields.DocComment: byte offset from start of file

nodes.Name: Span
nodes.DocComment: Span covers a contiguous region [Start, End).

nodes.Name: IsValid
nodes.DocComment:
Patched in v18 (D1#1): the prior implementation
    s.Start.Offset < s.End.Offset || s.Start.Line > 0
returned true for any span whose Start.Line was set, including the
inverted span {Start:{Line:1,Offset:5}, End:{Line:1,Offset:3}} that
the test fixture deliberately marks invalid. The corrected predicate
treats a span as valid iff both endpoints carry a positive line and
the start does not lie after the end (compared by line first, then
offset for same-line spans).

nodes.Name: TypeRef
nodes.DocComment:
TypeRef is a simplified, language-agnostic type reference.
It captures enough structure to reason about compatibility
without reproducing a full type checker.

nodes.Name: UnknownType
nodes.DocComment: UnknownType is returned when we cannot parse a type expression.

nodes.Name: Parameter
nodes.DocComment: Parameter represents one parameter of a function or method.

nodes.Name: Field
nodes.DocComment: Field represents one field in a struct, class, or interface.

nodes.Name: EnumMember
nodes.DocComment: EnumMember represents one value in an enum.

nodes.Name: Node
nodes.DocComment:
Node is the unified AST element. Fields are populated according
to Kind — see inline comments for which fields are relevant.

nodes.Name: Module
nodes.DocComment:
Module is the top-level result of parsing one source file.
It corresponds to one file regardless of language.

Fields.Name: PackageName
Fields.DocComment: Go package, Python module, TS module name

nodes.Name: TopLevelByKind
nodes.DocComment: TopLevelByKind returns all top-level nodes matching one or more kinds.

nodes.Name: UnknownNodes
nodes.DocComment:
UnknownNodes returns all NodeUnknown entries at any depth.
Used by the presentation layer to build the "needs human review" list.

nodes.Name: ParseError
nodes.DocComment:
ParseError captures a specific location where parsing failed or
where the parser had to make an assumption.

Fields.Name: Recoverable
Fields.DocComment: true: we emitted an NodeUnknown and continued
